end.summary: Named earthworm and ant as animals found in soil or leaf litter.
end.parentNote: Asha practised naming small soil animals and discussing how earthworms make holes that let water enter the soil. Pihu also identified ants and described seeing them walk in a line. Pihu repeated the idea that earthworms spoil soil; this was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, look under a leaf together and name two animals found there, including one helpful role of earthworms.
